summary: Truck dimensions "height,width,length" in cm. mode=truck only.
businessRules: truck_size defines: Specify the truck dimensions, in centimeters, in the format of “height,width,length”. Please note that this parameter is effective only when mode=truck.
Must stay consistent with: options.routing.mode. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
